character: Fictional 16.4km closed-course mountain pass in Nagano Prefecture, Japan, with 144 turns and 826m of elevation gain — the tallest track in Forza Motorsport. Blind hairpins, tunnels, and drastic elevation changes dominate; no individual corners have established names, so this is a track for memorisation and rhythm rather than corner-specific technique.
notes: Community knowledge (no formal corner-name guide available). This is a fictional 144-turn, 16.4km mountain-pass circuit — track character is sourced from Forza's official design article (forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-fujimi-kaido); no individual corners have established names.

corners.name: Lower Forest Hairpins
corners.type: tight, tree-lined hairpin sequence near the base of the mountain
corners.technique: Patient, low-speed precision, prioritise clean exits to carry speed into the climb
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed in and running out of track on the tight, blind hairpins

corners.name: Mid-Mountain Tunnels
corners.type: blind tunnel sections with sudden light changes
corners.technique: Commit on memory of the racing line, stay smooth through the reduced visibility
corners.trap: Hesitating in the reduced-visibility tunnels costs significant time

corners.name: Upper Mountain Switchbacks
corners.type: steep, arid switchback section near the summit (23-degree grade)
corners.technique: Patient braking on the steep sections, precise turn-in on each switchback
corners.trap: Misjudging braking distance on the steepest sections of the track
